subject: Post-penetration test: request for fix verification artifacts (FinPros)
messages:
From: Alex Moran <alex.moran@finpros.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: security@finpros.com
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 14:06:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up on PT findings - evidence of remediations

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for taking the time during the debrief earlier this week. Our security team has reviewed the pen test report and needs evidence for the fixes you mentioned on the call: specifically the VPC subnet hardening, the KV-cache isolation change, and the remediation ticket for the unauthenticated admin endpoint.

Can you share: screenshots of the updated VPC routes/security groups, the config snippet that shows KV-cache ACLs, and the ticket(s) showing closure and verification steps? We prefer PDF or PNG artifacts and a short summary we can attach to our audit folder.

Target date for our compliance window is Apr 6 — if you can send initial artifacts this week that would be helpful.

Best,
Alex
Security Engineer, FinPros
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Alex Moran <alex.moran@finpros.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up on PT findings - evidence of remediations

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. I'm looping in Rishi (eng) and Naomi (compliance) to gather the artifacts and give a short verification note.

Quick plan:
- Rishi will attach the VPC screenshots and the KV-cache config export.
- We'll include the remediation ticket with timestamps and post-fix verification steps (JIRA SEC-4521).
- Naomi will draft a 1-page summary you can drop into your audit folder.

We should be able to send a consolidated packet by EOD Tue (Mar 31). If anything is missing we will call out compensating controls.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Alex Moran <alex.moran@finpros.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up on PT findings - evidence of remediations

Alex / Lauren — attaching the artifacts we captured during remediation. Items included: 
- redwood_vpc_fix_screenshot.png (screenshot of updated route table and security group rules showing 10.0.0.0/16 restriction)
- kv-cache-config-export.json (exported ACLs and namespace isolation config; note: we rotated auth tokens and applied namespace-level ACLs on Mar 24)
- ticket-4521-change-log.txt (JIRA export showing timeline: discovery -> patch -> deploy -> verification)
- penetration-remediation-summary.pdf (high-level description of fixes + verification checklist)

Notes: the unauthenticated admin endpoint was mitigated by a two-step change: 1) auth requirement on the admin route, 2) WAF rule added to block known exploit signatures. Evidence for the WAF rule is the screenshot and the change-log entry. For KV-cache, because we couldn't fully remove shared residency for legacy customers immediately, we added namespace isolation + token scoping as a compensating control (documented in the PDF).

If you need raw logs proving post-fix verification (we have search queries and short-term retention hooks), let me know and we can provide a time-bounded export under an NDA if required.

-Rishi
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Alex Moran <alex.moran@finpros.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 01 Apr 2026 08:22:00 -07:00

Alex — quick compliance note attached in the summary PDF: we provisioned compensating controls for the KV-cache isolation case while we complete the phased migration to per-tenant instances. The controls include token scoping, shortened token TTLs for admin tokens, enhanced monitoring with alerting thresholds, and an audit of access events.

We confirm the remediation ticket (SEC-4521) shows verification steps completed by our SRE runbook (step IDs 12-16) and the verification timestamp is Mar 25 2026 03:14:22 UTC. If FinPros would like, we can provide a short attestation signed by our compliance lead — please confirm the required format.

-Naomi
Sr. Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Moran <alex.moran@finpros.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Follow-up on PT findings - evidence of remediations

Thanks, team — received the packet and the summary. A couple of quick asks so our auditors can close the item: 
1) Can you export a short log snippet demonstrating a successful verification run (the post-patch access test) with timestamps (we don't need full logs, just the entries that match your verification step IDs)?
2) For the WAF rule, can you include the rule ID and a short note on how false positives are handled (we need to describe any risk to availability)?

If you can send those two items by Apr 6, we'll mark the finding resolved on our side. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alex
